mapper.select: select d.route_id from hls_rule_engine_route d, hls_rule_engine_condition hrc where d.rule_engine_id = #{ruleEngineId} and d.route_id = hrc.route_id and hrc.xcondition_value = 'function_code' and hrc.ycondition_value1 = #{functionCode} and hrc.enabled_flag='Y'
select hrr.route_result_value from hls_rule_engine_route d, hls_rule_engine_result hrr where d.parent_route_id = #{routeId} and d.route_id = hrr.route_id
